_note: E1 invoice-fraud attack fragment (P7-F). A fragment of the `social` block; the shell packet (P7-K) copies these keys into scenarios/awareness_e1_invoice_fraud/scenario.json.erb. All companies and people are fictional. The learner, a junior red-teamer in Brightwell Foods' finance team, impersonates the accounts contact at supplier Harlow Packaging and emails the finance manager (phish target `supplier_contact` = Adaeze Okafor) to change the bank details on an open invoice. No payload, no link, no attachment. See the P7-F report 'Docs hand-off' for the globals the shell must declare.

brightwell_finance_manager.text: Adaeze Okafor is Brightwell's Finance Manager and signs off supplier payments.
brightwell_finance_manager.subject: adaeze
brightwell_finance_manager.reduceNote: Keep the name and remit of whoever authorises payments off the public site; attackers target the signer.

harlow_supplier_contact.text: Accounts queries for supplier Harlow Packaging go to Derek Mason, derek.mason@harlowpackaging.example.
harlow_supplier_contact.subject: mason
harlow_supplier_contact.reduceNote: Do not publish a named supplier contact and address; it lets an attacker spoof a sender the finance team already trusts.

brightwell_open_invoice.text: Quarter-end note: invoice INV-2217 from Harlow Packaging is still open and due for payment this week.
brightwell_open_invoice.subject: adaeze
brightwell_open_invoice.reduceNote: Open invoice numbers and amounts posted publicly give a fraudster the exact pretext to reference.

brightwell_quarter_end.text: A finance post about the quarter-end rush to clear supplier invoices on time.
brightwell_quarter_end.subject: adaeze
brightwell_quarter_end.reduceNote: Staff posts about a payment deadline hand an attacker a ready-made reason to hurry you.

pretext_bank_change.text: Following up on {invoice}: our bank account has changed, so please update the payee details before you release payment.

pretext_statement.text: Please find our latest monthly statement for your records.

pretext_bank_change_calm.text: When you have a moment on {invoice}: our bank account has recently changed, so the payee details will need updating before the next payment run. No rush today.

ask_confirm.text: Can you confirm once the new details are saved?

ask_when_convenient.text: Just drop me a line whenever it's sorted.

seededMessages.subject: Authorised exercise: Brightwell Foods
seededMessages.body:
Hello,

This is the authorised Brightwell Foods exercise. In scope: this inbox and the people on it. Research the finance team, then write one message. Nothing leaves this account.

Red team lead

blocks.text: Harlow Packaging Ltd has supplied our cartons since 2019. Accounts queries go to Derek Mason, derek.mason@harlowpackaging.example.
Quarter-end: invoice INV-2217 from Harlow Packaging is still open and due for payment this week.

posts.text: Mad week in finance: quarter-end, and everyone wants their invoices paid yesterday.
The allotment is finally giving us tomatoes. Small wins.

primedFor.story: a bank-detail change on an open invoice from the supplier contact she already deals with

open.fail: Nothing about the sender or the subject made her open it.

senderTrust.pass: ✓ From the supplier contact she deals with
senderTrust.fail: She does not recognise this sender. She acts on invoice mail from the supplier contact already on file.
senderTrust.redFlag: The From line carries Derek Mason's real Harlow address, so it reads as the supplier she trusts, but it was forged: Harlow never sent it.

pretextRelevant.pass: ✓ Ties to an invoice she is expecting to pay
pretextRelevant.fail: No open invoice she can match this to, so no reason to act on it.

replies.landed: Thanks Derek, I'll get the payee details updated before we run payment.
replies.missed: Thanks, but I don't change payee details from an email. I'll ring Harlow on the number we already hold to check first.

hints: Who does Brightwell's finance team already trust for invoices from this supplier?
What open invoice could you tie the message to, so it reads as expected?
Set the From line to the supplier's accounts contact on file, not your own address.
